tagline: Deep sides and a yielding fibre-filled base, for the dog who tucks in, not stretches out.
lead: Your dog gets an enclosed little nest to tuck into, with deep sides to lean on and a soft, yielding base.
value: A deliberately soft, enclosed alternative to a firm foam mattress, with a zipped cover that comes off for a 30°C wash.
intro: Badger is a deep nest dog bed: a soft fibre-filled base surrounded by deep sides, with a zipped cover that removes for a 30°C wash. In Medium and Large.
points: Edges all round for tucking in and leaning against.
Fibre filling gives the base a soft, yielding feel.
The zipped cover comes off for the machine.
best_for: Dogs who burrow into soft bedding or sleep curled tightly against high sides, rather than stretched out on a firm mattress.
fit_note: We don't list exact measurements for this bed, so ask us before ordering. Measure your dog lying down, nose to base of tail, add 15–20cm, and compare with the space inside the sides.
care: Remove the zipped cover and wash it at 30°C, as the sewn-in label says. Air-dry fully before refitting.
seo_title: Deep Nest Dog Bed for Burrowers, Fibre-Filled | Snoozly
seo_description: An enclosed, soft nest for dogs who burrow and curl up tight. Deep-sided dog bed with a fibre-filled base and a 30°C washable zipped cover. Medium & Large.
